title: Insert Q/V-only LoRA into a fused QKV layer

blocks.text: A fused QKV projection keeps K unchanged and adds separate low-rank paths only to Q and V. The task is: Wrap a fused nn.Linear(D,3D) QKV projection with trainable rank-r updates on Q/V only. Freeze base weights/bias, initialize A randomly and B to zero, preserve K. Return the module; input may have arbitrary leading axes.

The inputs are `base`, `rank`, `alpha`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
